newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Transaero postpones share issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Transaero postpones share issue.

text.p: Russia's biggest private airline AO Aviatsionnaya Kompaniya Transaero is postponing a planned share issue for several reasons, including the fact that an audit to international standards is not yet ready, a senior company official said on Monday.
Transaero board secretary Alexei Andreyev told Reuters the company would not make the issue until the audit carried out by Ernst & Young had been completed.
"We still cannot name the exact date of the issue," Andreyev said.
"We cannot say when exactly the audit will be over," he said. "It is nearly over, but we do not yet have the results."
He added there were other factors that were holding up the issue, but refused to say what.
In May the company said it would decide when to make the issue at a shareholders' meeting on May 31, but since then it has postponed it many times.
The company has chosen ABN-Amro as its registrar.
Transaero's current shareholders are employees with 15 percent of shares, Russian national flag carrier Aeroflot with five percent of shares, design bureaus and households.
